1744.d: Pihtimuslik dialoog ema ja poja vahel, kus viimane justkui iseennast sundides üritab midagi väga olulist emale ära öelda. Mustvalges, dokumentaalsust rõhutava kareda ülesvõttega video põhiosas – esitatud piklikus kinoformaadis, mis lähtematerjalile omakorda  võõritusefekti lisab – domineerib poja dramaatiline eneseavamisponnistus ja ema ning ka vaataja venitatud ootus, et see miski, lõpuks ära öeldud saaks. Seda raamib argisem, värviline ja tavaformaadis lõik kaamera, valguse ja "esinejate" ülessättimisest.
1744.de: A confessional dialogue between mother and son, in which the latter, as if forcing himself, tries to say something very important to his mother. In the main part of the video, shot in black and white with a rough, documentary-emphasizing style – presented in an elongated cinematic format, which in turn adds an alienation effect to the source material – the son's dramatic effort at self-disclosure dominates, along with the prolonged expectation of the mother, and also the viewer, that this something will finally be said. This is framed by a more everyday, colour, standard-format segment showing the setting up of the camera, lighting and "performers".

1754.d: Fotofilm remiksib arhiivfotosid Kreenholmi Manufaktuurist kuuldemänguga Elfriede Jelineki näidendist „Mis juhtus pärast seda, kui Nora oma mehe maha oli jätnud ehk Ühiskondade toed“. 1950.-1960. aastatest pärit propagandistlikud mustvalged fotod tekstiilitööstuses töötavatest naistest on asetatud näidendi 15. stseeni konteksti, milles Nora on tulnud vabrikusse, et hoiatada naistöölisi ettevõtte peatse sulgemise eest ja kutsuda neid üles emantsipatsioonile. Teos kuulus 2012. aasta Manifesta kunstibiennaali näitusekomplekti, mille eest Marge Monkole eraldati rahvusvaheliselt mainekas Kesk-Ida-Euroopa kaasaegse kunsti toetamiseks asutatud Henkeli kunstipreemia.
1754.de: The photo-film remixes archival photographs from the Kreenholm Manufaktuur with a radio play based on Elfriede Jelinek's play "What Happened After Nora Left Her Husband or Pillars of Society". Black-and-white propagandistic photographs from the 1950s–1960s of women working in the textile industry are placed in the context of the play's 15th scene, in which Nora has come to the factory to warn the female workers of the company's impending closure and to call on them to embrace emancipation. The work was part of the exhibition package of the 2012 Manifesta art biennial, for which Marge Monko was awarded the internationally prestigious Henkel Art Award, established to support contemporary art in Central-Eastern Europe.

5465.d: Atlasskangale trükitud mustvalge talvine foto hüljatud välibasseinialast Kadriorus. Basseini ümbrus ja tribüün kaetud lumega, basseini seintel grafiti ja põhi üleni täidetud tikitud sätendavate torukujuliste helmestega. Töö kuulub autori 2005. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafika erialal kaitstud bakalaureusetöö komplekti "Basseinid".
5465.de: A black-and-white winter photograph printed on satin fabric, showing an abandoned outdoor pool area in Kadriorg. The surroundings of the pool and the stand are covered with snow, the pool walls bear graffiti and the bottom is entirely filled with embroidered sparkling tube-shaped beads. The work belongs to the author's set of works "Basseinid" ["Pools"], the bachelor's thesis defended in graphic art at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2005.

5466.d: Atlasskangale trükitud mustvalge sügisene foto hüljatud välibasseinialast Kadriorus. Basseini ja liumäe vaheline kiviplaatidega ala kaetud sambla, muru ja lehtedega, basseini seintel, tribüünil ja tribüüniga külgneval hooneosal grafiti, väikese basseini põhi üleni kaetud tumedate sätendavate torukujuliste helmestega. Töö kuulub autori 2005. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafika erialal kaitstud bakalaureusetöö komplekti "Basseinid".
5466.de: Black-and-white autumnal photograph printed on satin fabric of an abandoned outdoor swimming pool area in Kadriorg. The area with stone slabs between the pool and the water slide is covered with moss, grass and leaves; on the pool walls, the stand and the part of the building adjoining the stand there is graffiti, the bottom of the small pool is entirely covered with dark shimmering tube-shaped beads. The work belongs to the author's set of works "Basseinid" ("Pools"), defended as a bachelor's thesis in the printmaking speciality at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2005.

5641.de: On 162 A4 sheets, a depiction of a red or pink star - single or multiple, printed on one or both sides of the sheet. As the printer's ink cartridge runs empty, the image of the star becomes lighter, uneven. In the end, only an image consisting of thin stripes remains.

5756.d: Kolmeosaline, valdavalt intensiivsetes punastes, roosades toonides krobelise faktuuriga kompositsioon. Vasakul osal roosaga piiritletud suur naisenägu, suu, ninajoon, silm mustaga markeeritud. Paremal-keskel maali allosas udupunasel mustaga katkendlikult markeeritud lamava mehe poolfiguur. Väga reljeefne maalipind, mustad kontuurjooned ebaühlaselt sügavates maalikihtides.
5756.de: A three-part composition, predominantly in intense red and pink tones, with a coarse texture. On the left part a large woman's face outlined in pink, mouth, nose line, eye marked in black. On the right-centre, in the lower part of the painting, the half-figure of a lying man marked intermittently in black on a hazy red ground. A very relief-like painted surface, black contour lines in unevenly deep paint layers.

6346.d: Süngetes toonides öine maastik kahe seisva figuuriga. Puudega ääristatud surnuaed, hauakivid rohus, keskel mees ja naine otsevaates, ülakehad paljastatud. Mees kivi peale pissimas, tema kõrval punases seelikus ja peakattes naine sellele sõrmega osutamas, teises käes avatud raamat. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis, mustjad, sünged toonid.
6346.de: A nocturnal landscape in somber tones with two standing figures. A cemetery bordered by trees, gravestones in the grass, in the middle a man and a woman seen frontally, upper bodies bared. The man is urinating onto a stone, beside him a woman in a red skirt and headdress pointing at it with her finger, in her other hand an open book. Expressive manner of depiction, blackish, somber tones.

6347.d: Kaunistustega kõrge seljatoega istmel noor naine otsevaates, pea pööratud vasakule, käed leenil, paljajalu; seljas sinine rüü, hõlmad vaheliti, ümber pea mässitud punane rätt. Mõlemal pool naist suured pruunid koerad: vasak istub, paremapoolne lamab. Üldkoloriit tume, mustjast taustast joonistuvad välja figuurid.
6347.de: Young woman frontally seated on a high-backed decorated seat, head turned to the left, hands on the armrests, barefoot; wearing a blue robe with the flaps crossed, a red scarf wrapped around her head. Large brown dogs on both sides of the woman: the left one sits, the right one lies. Overall colouring dark, the figures stand out against a blackish background.

6598.dm: laius: 480.0 cm (4-osaline x h 6); kõrgus: 244.0 cm
6598.d: Valmiskujundite, aplikatsioonide, valdavalt kofreeritud pleki jm plekitükkidega kaetud ja osaliselt üle värvitud 4-osaline kompositsioon, keskmistel tahvlitel aatomiseene maalitud kujund, mille kohal reljeefsete tähtedega: THE END. Vasakul osal ümarkaareline nišš reljeefse hõbedase naisfiguuriga, viisnurk peaks. Paremal telliseimitatsioonis niššis hõbedane mehe reljeef, viisnurk pea asemel.
6598.de: A 4-part composition covered with ready-made shapes, appliqués, mostly embossed tin and other pieces of tin, and partly overpainted; on the middle panels a painted image of an atomic mushroom cloud, above which in relief letters: THE END. On the left part a rounded arch niche with a relief silver female figure, a pentagram for a head. On the right, in a niche imitating brick, a silver relief of a man, a pentagram instead of a head.

6690.d: Gooti aknaga võlvitud kabelis kuus vanemat meest leinamas, pead paljastatud, käed kõhul. Paremal, nende ees alusele asetatud sark - siniste nuppudega hiiglaslik mobiiltelefon. Maalil tumedad toonid, kohmakas kujutamisviis.
6690.de: In a vaulted chapel with a Gothic window, six older men mourning, heads bared, hands on their stomachs. On the right, in front of them, placed on a stand - a giant mobile phone with blue buttons. Dark tones in the painting, clumsy manner of depiction.

6691.d: Raudtee ääres, vaguni taustal keskmest vasakul naise 3/4 figuur veidi pöördes paremale. Punane seelik ja pearätt, roheline pluus seljas. Vasakus tõstetud käes videokaamera, paremas automaatrelv. Taamal, helesinise taeva taustal kaks ratsanikku ületamas raudteed, esimesel punalipp käes, tagumisel tõstetud mõõk. Tahtlikult kohmakas maalilaad.
6691.de: By the railway, against the background of a railway carriage, left of centre a woman's 3/4 figure slightly turned to the right. Red skirt and headscarf, green blouse. In her raised left hand a video camera, in her right an automatic weapon. In the background, against a light blue sky, two horsemen crossing the railway, the first with a red flag in hand, the one behind with a raised sword. Deliberately clumsy painting style.

6707.d: Maali keskmest vasakul ülalt valgustatud kera punaka omavarjuga piimjal sinkjashallil taustal, millel mustaga noolemärk kirjaga "valgus" osutamas alla kerale. Kuulist alumine pind ebaühtlaselt must üles suunatud noole ja valge kirjaga "horisont". Ülal- ja allääre keskel neljakandiline templimärk.
6707.de: Left of the centre of the painting, a sphere lit from above with a reddish self-shadow on a milky bluish-grey background, on which in black an arrow marked "valgus" [light] points down to the sphere. The lower surface of the sphere is unevenly black, with an upward-pointing arrow and the white inscription "horisont" [horizon]. In the middle of the top and bottom edges, a rectangular stamp mark.

7575.d: Maali keskmest paremal ülalt valgustatud kera punaka omavarjuga ühtlaselt mustal taustal, millesse sissekraabitud kiri "valgus" ja noolemärk osutamas alla kerale. Kuulist alumine osa laia pintsliga maalitud kirsipunane, heledat läbi kumav pind. Ülaservas väiksem ja allservas suurem valge neljakandiline templimärk.
7575.de: Right of the centre of the painting, a ball lit from above with reddish self-shadow on an evenly black background, into which the word "valgus" (light) and an arrow pointing down at the ball are scratched. The lower part of the ball is painted with a broad brush in cherry red, a bright, translucent surface. In the upper edge a smaller and in the lower edge a larger white square stamp mark.

7645.d: Tervet maali pinda kattev vanaroosat tooni T-tähe geomeetriline kujund kreemvalgel taustal, millest kumab läbi korrapärase sõrestiku jooned.
7645.de: A geometric shape of a T letter in an old-rose tone covering the whole surface of the painting on a creamy white background, through which lines of a regular grid shine.

7653.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest minimalistlik kompositsioon: sinkjasvalgel taustal kollakasvalge T-kujund, millel värvi pressitud peened horisontaaltriibud.
7653.de: A minimalist composition of geometric shapes: a yellowish-white T-shape on a bluish-white background, with fine horizontal stripes pressed into the paint.

7654.d: Minimalistlik kompositsioon ristkülikutest: lõheroosal taustal valkjas koloriidis T-kujund, millel neli laia põikitriipu.
7654.de: Minimalist composition of rectangles: on a salmon-pink background a whitish T-shape with four wide transverse stripes.

7655.d: Minimalistlik kompositsioon ristkülikutest: keskmes oranžikas T-kujund kahvatukollasel taustal. Tervet maali katab peenejooneline korrapärane ruudustik.
7655.de: Minimalist composition of rectangles: in the centre an orangish T-shape on a pale yellow background. The entire painting is covered with a fine-lined regular grid.

7797.d: Mäekuplite vahel kääruline sünkhall veekogu, mille vahel sügisvärvides puudega poolsaar. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
7797.de: A winding, dark grey body of water between hill domes, with a peninsula with trees in autumn colours between them. Expressive manner of depiction.

7906.d: Talvine maastik. Keskel lumiste katustega hooneid, vasemal ja paremal puid, ees lage väli.
7906.de: Winter landscape. In the middle buildings with snowy roofs, trees on the left and right, open field in front.

8797.d: Pruunides, samblastes summutatud sügistoonides põikitriibuline abstraktne kompositsioon. Maalipinnase kinnitatud triipudena hõredalt riiet, paberit, köit jm., mis mitmekihiliselt, kohati voolavate niredena üle maalitud.
8797.de: An abstract composition in brown, mossy, muted autumn tones with cross-striped pattern. Sparsely attached to the painting ground as stripes are fabric, paper, rope etc., which are painted over in multiple layers, in places as flowing rivulets.

9747.d: Tervet maali kattev kohkunud ilmega, veidi punnis- pruunisilmne habeme ja vuntsidega mehe nägu otsevaates. Heleda juuksetüükaga kaetud pea, kortsus otsmik, veidi paokil suu. Kollasetriibuline särgikaelus pisut paistmas. Valge, oranži, pruunikaga maalitud nägu, ooker-kollane taust. Popilik kujutamisviis. Paremal äärel allpool kiri ülalt alla: VANAMEES.
9747.de: The whole painting is covered by the frontal face of a startled-looking, slightly bulging brown-eyed man with a beard and moustache, viewed frontally. Head covered with light hair stubble, wrinkled forehead, mouth slightly ajar. A yellow-striped shirt collar showing slightly. The face painted in white, orange and brownish tones, ochre-yellow background. A pop-like manner of depiction. On the right edge below, an inscription reading from top to bottom: VANAMEES.

9761.d: Eredal punakas-roosakal taustal lamav mustas rõivastuses mees, põlved püsti, pärani suuga pea kuklas, küünarnukkideni paljad käed rüpes.
9761.de: A man dressed in black lying against a bright reddish-pink background, knees raised, mouth wide open with head thrown back, bare arms up to the elbows resting in his lap.

9773.d: Kolm järjestikku asetsevat kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutavat plaati; vasakpoolne ots puna-musta-oranži triibuline läheb üle monokroomseks must-valgeks ja paremalt lõpeb sügavsinise-mustaga.
9773.de: Three narrow striped bar-code-like plates arranged in a row; the left end, striped in red-black-orange, transitions into monochrome black and white, and ends on the right in deep blue-black.

9818.de: Against a light background, a dark-toned nude figure of a man crouching on his heels with his back to the viewer, head turned in profile to the right.

9847.d: Maali naturaalne linane taust on kaetud mustjaslillakate kaarjate joonte, punktiiriga, mis teose keskmes muutub tihedamaks joonte, täppide vertikaalseks rägastikuks. Värvaine on kantud lõuendile maali tagaküljelt.(eesti)
9847.de: The natural linen background of the painting is covered with blackish-purple curved lines and dotting, which becomes denser at the centre of the work into a vertical thicket of lines and dots. The paint has been applied to the canvas from the back of the painting.

9887.d: Kollane taust valgete laiade pintsli-harjatõmmetega korrapäraselt triipudeks maalitud nii, et ülal 8 võrdset vertikaalset jaotust, allpool põikitriibud. Valgete pindade peale paigutatud korrapäraselt punaste numbrite templijäljed. Maali külgedel kollasega värvitud eenduvate naelte rida.

10056.de: Portrait of a woman in a three-quarter turn to the right, wearing a black blouse with thin ribbons, three pairs of scissors placed on her chest.

10059.d: Mustajuukselise, paljastatud rindadega naise portree veerandpöördes paremale.
10059.de: Portrait of a dark-haired woman with exposed breasts, in a three-quarter turn to the right.

10066.de: Portrait of a woman in a white blouse and black skirt holding glasses, décolleté open to the breasts.

10099.d: Kahest osast koosnev, must-valgetes toonides antud, pead käte vahele toetuva vana naise portree. Pildipinnal valgeid abstraktseid, teineteist läbistavaid jooni.
10099.de: A two-part portrait, given in black-and-white tones, of an old woman resting her head between her hands. On the picture surface white abstract lines intersecting one another.

10110.d: Punakates ja rohekates toonides ekspressiivne kompositsioon voolavate värvijugadega. Vasakul tahapoole nõjatuv inimfiguur, paremal abstraktsest värvipinnast esile tulev inimnägu.
10110.de: An expressive composition in reddish and greenish tones with flowing streams of colour. On the left a human figure leaning backward, on the right a human face emerging from an abstract field of colour.

10111.d: Tumedates rohekates ja punakates toonides poolabstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskmes heledatest värviniredest moodustuvad kaks figuuri. Taevast markeeriv osa tumeroheline, maad markeeriv osa tumepunane, all vasakus nurgas linnupesa kolme munaga.
10111.de: A semi-abstract composition in dark greenish and reddish tones, in the center of which two figures are formed from light streaks of color. The part marking the sky is dark green, the part marking the earth is dark red, in the lower left corner a bird's nest with three eggs.

10112.d: Punakates, rohekates ja roosades toonides poolabstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskmes ettepoole kallutatud inimfiguure meenutavad värvipinnad. Taevast markeeriv osa punakates-roosakates ning maad markeeriv osa sinakates-rohekates toonides, maalilaad kohati pastoosne, kohati laseeriv.
10112.de: A semi-abstract composition in reddish, greenish and pink tones, at the centre of which are colour surfaces reminiscent of human figures leaning forward. The part marking the sky is in reddish-pinkish tones and the part marking the earth in bluish-greenish tones, the painting technique is at times pastose, at times glazed.

10196.d: Kompositsiooni keskmeks on end konksu tõmmanud
10196.de: The centre of the composition is a figure that has curled itself into a hook.

10197.d: Teose keskseks motiiviks on abstraktsed kaks labajalga ja käsi. Maalitud tumehallides, mustades ja punastes toonides hoogsate pintsilöökidega.
10197.de: The central motif of the work is two abstract feet and a hand. Painted in dark grey, black and red tones with vigorous brushstrokes.

10198.d: Kompositsiooni keskseks motiiviks on kägarasse positsiooni tõmbunud abstrakne figuur tumehallides toonides. Taust helehall, paremal alumises servas verepritsmeid meenutavad jäljed.
10198.de: The central motif of the composition is an abstract figure drawn into a curled-up position, in dark grey tones. The background light grey, in the lower right corner marks resembling blood splatters.

10270.d: Helesinise gradatsiooniga taustal kujutatud hallika figuuri ülemist kehaosa. Figuuri pea on langetatud ja käed rüppes.
10270.de: The upper part of a greyish figure depicted against a background with a light blue gradation. The figure's head is lowered and hands rest in the lap.

10271.d: Sinise gradatsiooniga taustal kujutatud hallikates-sinakates toonides figuuri ülemist kehaosa. Figuur toetab oma küünernukke justkui lauale, hoides käes valget pliiatsit.
10271.de: Against a background with blue gradation, the upper part of a figure's body is depicted in greyish-bluish tones. The figure rests its elbows as if on a table, holding a white pencil in its hand.

10272.d: Helesinise gradatsiooniga taustal žestikuleerib hallikas figuur kätega: vasaku käe laba on pööratud taeva poole, parema käe pöial ja nimetissirm justkui hoiaksid midagi väikest.
10272.de: Against a background with a pale blue gradation, a grayish figure gestures with its hands: the palm of the left hand is turned towards the sky, the thumb and index finger of the right hand as if holding something small.

10273.d: Taevalaotuses hõljub kiilakas naisakt punaste kontsakingadega ja veiniklaasiga. Tema kohal avaneb punakas taevavõlv inglitega. Akti vaatlevad maali mõlemas servas seisvad tõbised figuurid roosa rüüga, kelle vahel suitsevad tööstushoonete torud. Maali alumises servas kujutatud punakates ja purpur toonides figuure joomas ja suitsetamas.
10273.de: In the vault of the sky a bald female nude hovers, wearing red high-heeled shoes and holding a wine glass. Above her a reddish heavenly vault opens with angels. The nude is observed by sickly figures in pink robes standing at both edges of the painting, between whom smoking industrial building chimneys appear. In the lower edge of the painting, figures in reddish and purple tones are depicted drinking and smoking.

10274.d: Ookri taustal figuuri rindportree profiilis vasakule. Mööda kujutatu nägu sibavad kärbseid meenutavad putukad.
10274.de: Bust portrait of a figure in profile to the left against an ochre background. Insects resembling flies crawl over the face of the subject.

10275.d: Tumerohelisel taustal figuuri rindportree profiilis vasakule. Kiilaka portreteeritu nahk on kaetud rõugeid meenutava naha deformatsiooniga.
10275.de: On a dark green background, a bust portrait of a figure in profile facing left. The skin of the bald sitter is covered with a pox-like skin deformation.

10279.d: Vasakust servast ülemisse paremasse serva kulgeb rida sarnaste peadega. Kujutatud isikute silmad on sinakad-hallid ja pead kiilakad- nähtaval on vaid pool nägu.
10279.de: From the left edge to the upper right edge runs a row of similar heads. The eyes of the depicted persons are bluish-grey and the heads bald – only half of the face is visible.

10281.d: Valgel taustal kujutatud tosin figuure rindportrees vasakule. Figuuridel seljas õhulised valged rüüd, mis justkui kulgevad valgetest pudelitest välja. Ühel figuuril jookseb mööda põske pisar.
10281.de: Against a white background, a dozen figures depicted in bust portrait facing left. The figures wear airy white robes that seem to emerge out of white bottles. On one figure a tear runs down the cheek.

10490.dm: kogus: 29.0 tk (figuriinide arv); kõrgus: 21.5 cm (figuriinid); laius: 9.5 cm (figuriinid); sügavus: 80.0 cm (kuppel)
10490.d: Koosneb 29 figuriinist (28 kipsist + 1 steariinist), värvitud spreivärviga (autode kruntvärv, tumehall), osad kaetud PVA liimiga, osadel kostüümi detailid värvitud akrüüliga, 1 kaetud naturaalse kollase villaga) + 1 valgest steariinist figuriin. Figuriinide kõrgus 21,5 cm; laius 9,5 cm, sügavus 7 cm. Figuriinid on asetatud bordoopunase sünteetilise plüüškangaga kaetud alusele. Alus figuriinidega on kaetud pleksiklaasist kupliga mõõdus 80x80 x h 70 cm. Kogu kompositsiooni ümbritseb neljast messingtooni metallpostist ja neljast punase plüüshiga kaetud piirdetrossist moodustatud piire. Figuuride  ümber on seotud punane siidpael.
10490.de: Consists of 29 figurines (28 plaster + 1 stearin), painted with spray paint (car primer paint, dark grey), some covered with PVA glue, on some the costume details are painted with acrylic, 1 covered with natural yellow wool) + 1 figurine of white stearin. Height of figurines 21.5 cm; width 9.5 cm, depth 7 cm. The figurines are placed on a base covered with burgundy-red synthetic plush fabric. The base with the figurines is covered with a plexiglass dome measuring 80x80 x h 70 cm. The entire composition is surrounded by a barrier formed of four brass-toned metal posts and four barrier ropes covered with red plush. A red silk ribbon is tied around the figures.

11819.d: Kirvemees ajab mööda korterit taga tõenäoliselt tema enda naist ja kahte last. Naine ja lapsed proovivad ennast igale poole ära peita -  küll diivani või voodi taha või kapi taha või teki alla, aga kirvemees leiab nad alati üles ja siis juhtub midagi. Ja iga kord peale seda midagi on kirvemees ikka rohkem ja rohkem verega koos. Naine ja kaks last aga näevad järjest paremad välja. Ja nii muudkui lõputult. (Marko Mäetamm)
11819.de: An axe-man is chasing through the apartment, probably his own wife and two children. The woman and children try to hide themselves everywhere - behind the sofa or bed, or behind the cupboard, or under the blanket, but the axe-man always finds them and then something happens. And each time after that something, the axe-man is more and more covered in blood. But the woman and the two children look better and better. And so it goes on endlessly. (Marko Mäetamm)

11831.d: Videos vaade aknast välja, väljas paistavad tuule käes liikuvad puuoksad. Kulunud vanaaegses köites, marliga kinni seotud raamat, esiküljel marlipaelade ristumiskohal vatipadjake. Raamatul "peas" luitunud valge beebimüts. Raamat asetseb videoekraani ees keskel.
11831.de: In the video, a view out of a window, outside branches of a tree moving in the wind can be seen. A worn book in an antique binding, tied with gauze, with a cotton pad at the crossing point of the gauze ribbons on the front cover. On "top" of the book a faded white baby's bonnet. The book is placed in the middle in front of the video screen.

11832.dm: aeg/ kestus: 17.0 minut; aeg/ kestus: 18.0 sekund
11832.d: Esiplaanil paremal valgete linade vahel külili lamava naise (E.-L. Semper) ülakeha. Naise kätes näo juures väike elus hiir. Taustal jooksevad panoraamid suvistest maastikest.
11832.de: In the foreground, on the right, the upper body of a woman (E.-L. Semper) lying on her side amid white sheets. In the woman's hands, near her face, a small live mouse. In the background, panoramas of summer landscapes running past.

11834.d: Ülal keskel tekst "All Things Electric". Vahelduvad kaks tehismaastikku kujutavat motiivi ja kaks inglisekeelset tekstiplokki. Ülemisel pildil mees mustas ülikonnas, käes kohver ja kepp. Taevas planeeditaoline objekt. Mehe rinda ja objekti ühendab valge looklev joon. All vasakul draakoni  kujutis. Alumisel pildil tehismaastik, millest tõusevad kaks koonuse kujulist ja üks silinderjas moodustis. Neid ümbritseb puudesalu.  All paremal kõndiv inimfiguur.
11834.de: At the top centre, the text "All Things Electric". Two motifs depicting artificial landscapes alternate with two blocks of English text. In the upper image, a man in a black suit, holding a suitcase and a cane. In the sky, a planet-like object. A white winding line connects the man's chest to the object. At the bottom left, a depiction of a dragon. In the lower image, an artificial landscape from which two cone-shaped and one cylindrical formation rise. They are surrounded by a grove of trees. At the bottom right, a walking human figure.

11840.d: Interaktiivne video- ja heliinstallatsioon. Videoprojektsioon seinal, mille ees seisab mikrofon. Vaataja peab teose aktiveerimiseks mikrofoni laulma või muul moel häält tegema. Ekraanil liibuvas erksavärvilises spordirõivastuses  naine (Mare Tralla), kes reageerides vaataja häälele hakkab erineval moel laulma, liigutama ja hüppama. Taustaks Tallinna Lauluväljaku lava.
11840.de: An interactive video and sound installation. A video projection on the wall, in front of which stands a microphone. To activate the work, the viewer must sing or otherwise make a sound into the microphone. On the screen, a woman (Mare Tralla) in tight brightly coloured sportswear, who, reacting to the viewer's voice, begins to sing, move, and jump in various ways. In the background, the stage of the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds.

11868.de: A site-specific installation consisting of 18 transparent stickers depicting various actions and icons as black symbols. 12005.de: A performance at the survey exhibition of Pärnu art curated by Andrus Joonas at the Pärnu New Art Museum, where Mari Kartau appears in the exhibition hall in a red dress, undresses in front of the audience, throws the dress together with keys taken from around her neck and ear into the crypt of the exhibition hall, and beneath the dress a chastity belt bound together with a metal grid and padlocks becomes visible. The artist herself also descends into the illuminated crypt lined with white cloth, at the bottom of which red rose blossoms and keys are scattered, fastens herself to the floor construction with straps, and begins slowly, fibre by fibre, to cut through the rope holding her with scissors. 12006.d: Installatsioon ja performance Tanel Saare isikunäitusel Haapsalu Linnagaleriis, kus grupp alasti gaasimaskides kunstnikke imiteerivad häälitsuse saatel terade nokkimist näitusesaali põrandalt. Ühel hetkel hakatakse kunstnikke publiku seast pilduma toorete munadega, mispeale kunstnikud ükshaaval näitusesaalist lahkuvad. Seejärel heidab üks kunstnikest põrandale pikali, teised aga hakkavad seinalt sinna ühtlase kihina kinnitatud kanajalgasid korjama ja neid lamavale kunstnikule peale heitma, kuni viimane üleni kanajalgadega kattub. Performance toimus Tanel Saare ärakeelatud isikunäituse avamisel ja lõpetamisel Haapsalu Linnagaleriis 28. märtsil 2001. aastal. Näitus koosnes 5000 näitusesaali se
12006.de: An installation and performance at Tanel Saar's solo exhibition at the Haapsalu Linnagalerii, where a group of naked artists in gas masks imitate the pecking of grain from the floor of the exhibition hall accompanied by vocalisations. At one point the artists are pelted with raw eggs from among the audience, whereupon the artists leave the exhibition hall one by one. Then one of the artists lies down flat on the floor, while the others begin to collect chicken feet attached in an even layer to the wall and throw them onto the artist lying down, until the latter is completely covered with chicken feet. The performance took place at the opening and closing of Tanel Saar's banned solo exhibition at the Haapsalu Linnagalerii on 28 March 2001. The exhibition consisted of 5000 chicken feet attached to the exhibition hall wall

12059.de: "Eternal Fire" is a staged documentary film about love for propagated role models. A girl raised in the Soviet spirit is taught to respect heroes, reminders of whom in the form of bronze sculptures filled our whole town. But the girl's faith in the ideal finds expression in love for a sacred image. For a girl who grew up in the era of the Soviet atheist state order, this is the Bronze Soldier of Tõnismägi. But the soldier is unable to bear the embodiment of Eternal Love...

47509.d: The Estonian Pavilion at the 49th Venice biennial was a collaboration between artists Ene-Liis Semper and Marko Laimre at La Fondazione Ugo e Olga Levi, Palazzo Giustinian Lolini. Ene-Liis Semper and Marko Laimre came to art more or less at the same time, somewhere in the mid-1990s. The first as a dangerous heroine of ritual performances and with body-focused videos; the other with actions laced by meta-art strategies and installations with an anarcho-political flavour. The work of both Laimre and Semper seems to indicate that a fundamental error, a complication, or at least a disharmony has been written into the elaborate mechanism of the present existence; and they are trying to capture it. Both have used their own selves and body as material, and have moulded the data of their personal histories into art. This is still very important to them. As strong personalities, the two artists have touched the borders of society’s threshold of tolerance and pain, either unwittingly or on purpose. The critics have seen them as radicals, and this is what they certainly are – both consider the rules set by society as repressive. Their artistic handwriting, however, has a fairly different colo

47511.d: John Smith. Marko und Kaido. The Estonian Pavilion at the 50th Venice biennale John Smith (artist duo Kaido Ole and Marko Mäetamm) represented Estonia at the 50th Venice biennial with a show called “Marko und Kaido”, curated by Anders Härm at Palazzo Malipiero. Curator Anders Härm: “Yes, you are not mistaken – John Smith is the artist representing Estonia this year at the Venice biennial and the project is called “Marko und Kaido”. John Smith, of course, is a fictional character. He is the constantly changing Conceptual Persona of two artists, Marko Mäetamm and Kaido Ole, who have for years shared a studio. Under these circumstances – working side by side – the third guy John with a third point of view was born. 47527.d:
Be Drunk, Be Very, Very Drunk talks about the relationship between alcohol and philosophy. Based on Deleuze and Guattari, Anders Härm links becoming an (conceptual) idiot with alcohol, and later reaches Guy Debord considering Situationists International the first deliberately drunk revolution. The brandy consumed in the course of the lecture makes the academic presentation an ironic human experiment which tests the limits of acceptable and non-acceptable. The criticism does not fall only on the academical mannerism but also on the academy as an institution that is based on over-exploited concepts which smother creativity.

The documentation of the performance was born as an exchange with Latvian Television, who insisted a post-presentation interview from the lecturer before the performance. Härm agreed on the condition that the Latvian Television records the performance from the beginning. The recording reached the lecturer but the interview was dropped.

The series of paintings named Tip of the Day was first exhibited in the Tallinn Art Hall exhibition Violence & Propaganda in 2006. The series consists of nine paintings, the texts of which were based on what was being said in the media.  Its core lies in the Guantanamo (Gitmo) prison camp, which was not subject to the Geneva Convention (III) concerning the rights and general human rights of ‘prisoners of war’ before July 2006. Focusing on three key elements – a gun, Casio watches and olive green – which should serve as the terrorists’ ‘field-marks’. The author raises questions concerning the background and reasons of placing people in prison camps. The series of paintings has been acquired in return for everlasting free entrance to EKKM exhibitions, even though Elin Kard is a member of the board of EKKM  and all exhibitions at EKKM are free.

Elin Kard: ‘At that time I read a lot of different materials from the foreign press about the Guantanamo (Gitmo) prison camp which at that time still operated. In my recollection various people who ended up in Gitmo were asked when, where, and on what grounds they were arrested. The staff was asked what the so called ‘external features’ are, which help to recognize terrorists. The required elements or elements that could be misleading were: possession of a gun, the Casio F-91W wristwatch and the use of olive green in clothing’.

Superflex, the well-known Danish art group, participated in the KUMU opening exhibition titled Shift Scale in 2006 with its non-alcoholic vodka project. Non-alcoholic vodka tastes like vodka but does not contain alcohol. The work seems to comment on uniqueness being lost in globalization – the need to comply with the demands and requirements of international markets and a struggle for survival amongst existing products sets a certain framework, of which being outside of is not beneficial to the product. Non-alcoholic vodka is a good example of a product being outside of said framework.

Hanno Soans, the curator of contemporary art in KUMU at the time and one of the organizers of the exhibition, acquired one of the bottles at the exhibition and donated it to the EKKM collection on the condition that a member of the management board of EKKM, Marco Laimre gets a bottle of alcohol free beer at the NOKU club without paying for it. The deal is yet to be completed, as Laimre has not been able to avoid paying at the bar.

by the artist duo Johnson and Johnson (Indrek Köster and Taavi Talve) raises the question of racial and ethnic sensitivity in an inevitably globalising Estonian society. The work consists of two stylised sculptures with their skin colours reversed: one depicts the head of a man with African features, the other with Caucasian features. Although their socially stigmatised characteristics have been exchanged, the two figures are united by national symbolism, prompting the question of to what extent Estonian culture belongs exclusively to ethnic Estonians.

“Can someone dressed in traditional Mulgimaa folk costume withstand a Ukrainian or Russian choir performing at the Song Festival? Can an African person wear a cornflower in their buttonhole? Is a foreign worker allowed only to work, or is pissing among the junipers and celebrating at beer festivals a privilege reserved only for? Is Eesti Energia’s accumulated capital outflows to Jordan’s oil shale fields an Estonia’s Business? Soundcheck is a test signal from the stage to the auditorium. Whether the response from the audience is ‘tolerant’ silence, the shouting of neo-Nazis, or something else entirely, depends on the audience itself.”
